caso.texto:
Beacon Group has six sites. Operations wants standard records, IT an access test, procurement vendor onboarding, and finance has not approved funds. The sponsor accepts a presentation but cannot contract. An expansion announcement was incorrectly recorded as approved budget.

An Indian group has regional operational leads and central accounts approval. The requested pilot spans two cities with different staffing availability. The supplier must confirm training support and invoicing requirements without assuming universal rollout.

projeto.instrucoes: Deliver an account plan, four-role map, sourced hypothesis and five coordinated actions, including conditions for reducing priority or closing.
projeto.gabarito: Correct budget to unknown. Verify multi-site capability and requirements before proposing a pilot. Coordinate operations, IT, procurement and finance with distinct purposes. Reduce effort or close when mandatory requirements cannot be met.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
